LanguageData.TF_Armed_Agrihand.label: armed agrihand
LanguageData.TF_Armed_Agrihand.description: An improved supply mechanoid derived from agrihand, its armor has been reinforced. Although it cannot carry supplies, it can throw hand grenades loaded in the cargo container in close range areas in emergency situations. When not in combat, it can also work like a gardening mechanoid.
LanguageData.TF_Armed_Agrihand.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.TF_ArmedLifter.label: recon lifter
LanguageData.TF_ArmedLifter.description: The reconnaissance carrier refitted from the abandoned kcco vanguard remains with a carrier can also use the internal space to load a combat machine because of the removal of the built-in energy weapons.
LanguageData.TF_ArmedLifter.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.TF_Misc.label: oddjob assister
LanguageData.TF_Misc.description: A small work mechanoid, designed to handle various simple tasks such as cutting bricks and rolling cigarettes. To cope with hazardous work environments, it has also been reinforced with armor and the pneumatic hammer used for crushing rocks can also play a role in close combat.
LanguageData.TF_Misc.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.TF_Misc.tools.pneumatic_hammer.label: pneumatic hammer
